Important article about ensuring the current wave of sexual assault advocacy & awareness raising doesn't devolve into another whitewashed movmt like #MeToo Australia did. 

But somewhat problematic to say these voices shd b heard & then erect paywall. 
https://t.co/4OK5DWFiJU https://t.co/1r3R3BQ1vc

This is not a comment on @mattcunningham who has written a timely piece on a critical issue (already identified by many Aboriginal writers in the past). 

Its a comment on the intersection of capitalism, media, race, & neoliberal values & where #MeToo finds expression within that

Right now we r at a crossroads with sexual assault advocacy. 

There is lot of noise, which is essential, but how we channel that is the next hurdle we must confront. 

We've been in this situation b4 in 2017 when #MeToo went viral. This time let' ensure we secure lasting change!

Part 3 of @AmberMaySchultz 's series on #MeToo for Crikey: 'All women need to benefit from Me Too, not just middle-class white ones'  https://t.co/licZEohJjW Great quotes from @nilminiferno Dr Nilmini Fernando https://t.co/f0DH8cPKVs
